history.perspective: B33 - Bundle/APK size audit for Play Store
history.outcome: GAP FOUND AND FIXED: release builds shipped with R8 minify + resource shrinking both off (no expo-build-properties plugin, no way to set the gradle property otherwise since android/ is gitignored/regenerated). Installed expo-build-properties@~1.0.10 (SDK-54-matched version, verified property-key compatibility against two other versions before trusting it) and enabled both flags in app.json. Verified end-to-end via a real expo prebuild that gradle.properties picks up both flags correctly.
